question: Which of the following is the output device of a computer?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Plotter**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **The plotter **was the first output to produce huge graphics and engineering drawings.
 
• It is currently referred to as a large format or wide format printer. Plotter printers are printers that print vector graphics.
